paite: Huan zawlneite tapate' zite lak a numei khat in Elisha kiang ah, "Na sikha, ka pasal ana sita hi. Na sikha in TOUPA alau chih na thei a; aleibatna pa'n ka tate anih ua sikha dia pi ding in ahong kuan hi," chi in amangbat thu ahilh hi.
heading: Elisha In Meithai Genthei Apanpih
english: Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is dead. You know that your servant feared Yahweh. Now the creditor has come to take for himself my two children to be slaves.”

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Bang ka hon hihsak dia? Hon hilh ve, inn ah bang na nei a?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikhanu'n sathau um khat kia lou ngal inn ah bangmah ka nei kei," achi hi.
english: Elisha said to her, “What should I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She said, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Va kuan inla, na invengte tengteng bel vuak va khelkhawm in; tam lou kia zaw khel ke'n.
english: Then he said, “Go, borrow empty containers from all your neighbors. Don’t borrow just a few containers.

paite: Na hong lut chiang in na tapate toh kong kikhakkhum unla, huai tuh tengteng ah sathau thun inla; adimdim in na tuamkoih ding,” achi hi.
english: Go in and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour oil into all those containers; and set aside those which are full.”

paite: Huchi in akiang a pan apaita a, amah leh atapate toh kong akikhakkhum ua; amau belte ahon la ua, ama'n ana thun zel hi.
english: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.

paite: Belte adim nung in, hichi ahong hi a, atapa kiang ah, "Bel hon la nawn dih," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Bel a-om nawn kei," achi hi. Huchi in sathau akangta hi.
english: When the containers were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another container.” He said to her, “There isn’t another container.” Then the oil stopped flowing.

paite: Huai khit in Pathian mipa kiang ah ava hoh a, thil omdan ava hilh hi. Ama'n, "Va pai inla, sathau va zuak inla, na leibat va din inla, aval in na tapate toh khosa un,” achi hi.
english: Then she came and told the man of God. He said, “Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt; and you and your sons live on the rest.”

paite: Ni khat Shunem ah Elisha ava zin hi. Huai ah numei neizoutak khat a-om hi. Ama'n an ne ding in ana sawl teitei hi. Huchi in apai peuhmah chiang in huai ah an ne ding in alut hi.
heading: Elisha Leh Shunem A Pan Numei Hausa
english: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.

paite: Ama'n apasal kiang ah, “Ngai in, hiai mi hon nawk zelpa Pathian misiangthoupa ahi, chih ka thei.
english: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.

paite: Kisa dih, inn pindan neu i bawlsak dia, lupna, dohkan, tutphah leh khawnvak koihna i koihsak ding. Huchi a i kiang a ahong chiang in alut zel ding,” achi hi.
english: Please, let’s make a little room on the roof. Let’s set a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp stand for him there. When he comes to us, he can stay there.”

paite: Ni khat ava hoh a, huai in pindan ah ava lut a, ava lum hi.
english: One day he came there, and he went to the room and lay there.

paite: Asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a ama ah ahong dingh hi.
english: He said to Gehazi his servant, “Call this Shunammite.” When he had called her, she stood before him.

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, nang nakpitak in na hon deihthoh a, bang ka hon hihsak sam dia, kumpipa hiam, sepaih heutu hiam hon houpihsak leng na ut hia? chi in akiang ah gen in," achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Ка chipihte lak mah a teng ka hi," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Say now to her, ‘Behold, you have cared for us with all this care. What is to be done for you? Would you like to be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army?’” She answered, “I dwell among my own people.”

paite: Ama'n, "Amah a dia bang hih ding ahia le?" achi hi. Gehazi in adawng a, "Tapa anei kei, apasal lah a-upata a," achi hi.
english: He said, “What then is to be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.”

paite: Ama'n, "Va sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, kong ah ahong dingh hi.
english: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood in the door.

paite: Ama'n, "Tu bang hun ahong tun nawn chiang in tapa na pomta ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Maizen, toupa, nang Pathian mipa in na sikhanu kiang ah zuaugen ke'n," achi hi.
english: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”

paite: Huchi in numei agai a, Elisha in akiang a, agen bang a ahun ahong tun nawn in tapa aneita hi.
english: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season when the time came around, as Elisha had said to her.

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian a, ni khat apa toh buh la mite kiang ah akuan hi.
english: When the child was grown, one day he went out to his father to the reapers.

paite: Apa kiang ah, "Ka lu, ka lu," achi hi. Apa'n sikha valnou khat kiang ah, "Pom inla, anu kiang ah paipih in," achi hi.
english: He said to his father, “My head! My head!” He said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”

paite: Apaipih a, anu kiang atun in aphei tung ah sun tan atu a, huchi in asita hi.
english: When he had taken him and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.

paite: Apaitou a, Pathian mipa lupna ah asial a, kong akhakkhum a, apawtta hi.
english: She went up and laid him on the man of God’s bed, and shut the door on him, and went out.

paite: Huchi in apasal asam a, "Sikha kuahiam leh sabiltung khat hon ngaihtuahsak dih ve, Pathian mipa kiang ah ka va tai dia, ka hong kik nawn ding,” achi hi.
english: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”

paite: Ama'n, "Bangziak a tuni chitchiat a akiang a hoh tum na hia? Kha thak leng ahi kei a, Sabbath leng ahi ngal kei a," achi hi. Ama'n, “Ahoih ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “Why would you want to go to him today? It is not a new moon or a Sabbath.” She said, “It’s all right.”

paite: Huchi in sabiltung abawl a, asikha kiang ah, "Hawl inla malam ah pai in, thu ka hon piak keileh awl pai ke'n," achi hi.
english: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”

paite: Huchi in apaita a, Pathian mipa kiang ah Karmel tang ah ava hoh hi. Pathian mipa'n gamlapi a pan ana muh in, hichi ahong hi a, asikha Gehazi kiang ah, "En in, huai ah Shunem numei a-om.
english: So she went, and came to the man of God to Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her afar off, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Behold, there is the Shunammite.

paite: Amah dawn ding in va tai inla, akiang ah, na dam hia? Na pasal adam maw? Naupang leng adam maw? va chi in,” achi hi. Ama'n ana dawng a, "Dam e," achi hi.
english: Please run now to meet her, and ask her, ‘Is it well with you? Is it well with your husband? Is it well with your child?’” She answered, “It is well.”

paite: Mual a Pathian mipa kiang ava tun in, akhe alen tinten a, amah hong sawnhang tum in Gehazi in ava naih hi. Himahleh Pathian mipa'n, "Bangmah chih ke'n, alungsim mangbang ahi. TOUPA'N ka lak ah asel a, ahon hilh nai kei hi,” achi hi.
english: When she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the man of God said, “Leave her alone, for her soul is troubled within her; and Yahweh has hidden it from me, and has not told me.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Ka toupa, tapa ka hon ngen a hia? Hon khem ke'n, ka hon chi hilou maw?" achi hi.
english: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”

paite: Huchi in Gehazi kiang ah, "Na puan teng inla, ka chiangkhun tawi in va hoh in. Kuapeuh mu lechin leng, chibai buk ke'n. Kuapeuh in chibai ahon buk uleh leng dawng ke'n. Naupang maitang ah ka chiangkhun va nga in," achi hi.
english: Then he said to Gehazi, “Tuck your cloak into your belt, take my staff in your hand, and go your way. If you meet any man, don’t greet him; and if anyone greets you, don’t answer him again. Then lay my staff on the child’s face.”

paite: Naupang nu'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka hon khah het kei ding,” achi hi. Huchi in athou a, azuita hi.
english: The child’s mother said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” So he arose, and followed her.

paite: Gehazi in amau ana makhelh a, naupang mai ah chiangkhun ana nga hi. Himahleh aw leh zak bangmah a-om kei. Huchi in houpih ding in akik nawn a, "Naupang hak het kei veh aw," chi in ahilh hi.
english: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”

paite: Elisha insung ava lutleh ngai in, naupang asi khinta a, alupna ah ana lumsak lai uhi.
english: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.

paite: Huchi in ava lut a, anih un kong akhakkhum a, TOUPA kiang ah athum hi.
english: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to Yahweh.

paite: Apaitou a, naupang abohkhum a, amuk leh amuk, amit leh amit, akhut leh akhut asutuah a; atung ah akizan a; huchi in naupang taksa ahong lum hiaihiai hi.
english: He went up and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands. He stretched himself on him; and the child’s flesh grew warm.

paite: Huchi in akik nawn a, insung ah akivialleh a; ahohtou a, atung ah abok a; huchi in naupang sagihvei ahong hahchiai a, ahong hakta hi.
english: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth, then went up and stretched himself out on him. Then the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

paite: Huchi in Gehazi asam a, "Hiai Shunem numei hon sam dih," achi hi. Ava sam a, akiang a ava lutleh, "Na tapa pom in," ana chi hi.
english: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up your son.”

paite: Huchi in ava lut a, akhebul ah abokkhup a, amai a lei si in akun a; atapa apom a, apawtkhia hi.
english: Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.

paite: Gilgal ah Elisha ahoh nawn hi. Huai gam ah kial akia hi. Zawlneite tapate ama ah atukhawm ua; ama'n asikha kiang ah, "Bel lianpi suang inla, zawlneite tapate an huansak in," achi hi.
heading: Thillamdang Om Lai Nihte
english: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a famine in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, “Get the large pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.”

paite: Mi khat gam ah meh zong in ava kuan a, gam khau ava mu a, agah khenkhat alou a, apuan in atun theih zah atun a, a-atnen a, bel sung ah akha hi. Bang ahia chih athei kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.

paite: Huchi in huai mite nek ding in asuakkhia ua, anhuan anek ualeh, hichi ahong hi a, "Ehe, Pathian mi, bel sung a sihna om akei maw,” achi kheukhou ua; ane theita kei uh.
english: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

paite: Ama'n, "Tangbuang hon la dih ua,” achi a; huai tuh ah akha hi, “Mite nek ding in hon suakkhe dih ua,” achi hi. Huchi in bel ah lauhuai bangmah a-omta kei hi.
english: But he said, “Then bring meal.” He threw it into the pot; and he said, “Serve it to the people, that they may eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.

paite: Baal-shalisha a pan mi khat ahong a, Pathian mipa a ding in buh thak masapen abawl barli buh sangpek sawmnih leh buh thak vui a-ip in ahon tawi a; ama'n, "Hiai mite nek ding in pia in," achi hi.
english: A man from Baal Shalishah came, and brought the man of God some bread of the first fruits: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give to the people, that they may eat.”

paite: Asikha in, "Bang e, mi zakhattak hiai ka lui ding maw?" achi hi. Ama'n hiai mite nek ding pia in. TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ane ding ua, akhamval lai ding uh," achi hi.
english: His servant said, “What, should I set this before a hundred men?” But he said, “Give it to the people, that they may eat; for Yahweh says, ‘They will eat, and will have some left over.’”

paite: Huchi in alui a, ane ua, TOUPA chih bang ngei in akhamval lai uhi.
english: So he set it before them and they ate and had some left over, according to Yahweh’s word.
